body:
Meeting: Applied ML weekly sync
Date: 2026-07-07
Attendees: Ava Martinez (owner), Daniel Kim, Priya Singh, Ethan Zhao, Maya Patel, plus: SRE + runtime interns (ad hoc)

1) Standup updates
- Ava: Focused on quantization integration and runtime PR cleanup. Ran H100 perf suite for q4-NF4 on Llama-3-13B. Drafted onboarding checklist for new q4 model variants.
- Daniel: Expanded Redwood-QEval v2 with additional factual QA and reasoning prompts. Found a regression signal tied to outlier-clipping in the quantizer.
- Priya: Working on prompt-level eval instrumentation and the eval dashboard. Started reconciling tokenization edge-cases between fp16 and quantized paths.
- Ethan: Validated basic serving behavior on Dedicated staging. Observed occasional OOM in seq=2048 tails with q4 when batching spikes - SRE investigating.
- Maya: Preparing customer guidance doc and pricing sensitivity notes for q4 profiles.

2) Quantization experiments (summary)
- Goal: Ship a conservative q4 profile (NF4-like) that gives large perf wins while preserving answer quality for production use.
- Results: On H100, q4 config yields ~2.7x token throughput and ~1.8x lower latency p50 for interactive batch sizes (8). On A100, improvements are still material (~2.2x) but lower than H100.
- Quality: Most intrinsic metrics hold (perplexity ~+3-4%), but a reproducible EM drop (~2.3 points) was found on our factual QA split when outlier-clipping was enabled in the quantizer. HumanEval and code generation unchanged.
- Action: Reverted the aggressive clipping flag in the CI quantization pipeline; investigating targeted clipping thresholds and per-layer heuristics.

3) Evals and diagnostics
- Redwood-QEval v2 now includes: factual QA (closed-book), multi-hop reasoning, instruction-following, and hallucination adversarial probes.
- Priya added prompt-level diffs: will surface tokens/positions where quantized output diverges from baseline. Early diffs suggest divergence concentrated at rare-token boundaries and entity spans.
- Next evals: run full suite across Llama-3-{7B,13B,70B} q4 profiles to verify cross-size behavior (Daniel).

4) Model onboarding checklist (status)
- Checklist drafted (items): model artifact provenance, tokenizer checks, perf profiles (fp16 baseline + q4), eval report, rollback profile, pricing guidance, metrics dashboard entries, Canary route config.
- Infra PR #1423 introduces kernel selection tweaks and an opt-in q4 codepath. PR currently green on unit tests; perf/regression gates pending.

5) Blockers / Risks
- Regression: factual QA EM drop tied to quantizer clipping - prevents safe automatic rollout until fixed.
- Infra: OOMs on long sequences when batch spikes hit q4 path on staging Dedicated - possible memory accounting bug in KV cache sizing for quantized tensors.
- Rollout risk: customers with strict determinism constraints may see rare token differences; need clear doc and canary strategy.

6) Next steps / plan for next week
- Prioritize root-cause on EM regression: reproduce with smaller set, trace per-layer activations, test relaxed clipping heuristics (Daniel + Priya).
- Finish runtime PR perf checks and merge if no further regressions (Ava).
- SRE to reproduce OOMs on a smaller repro and patch KV cache accounting or fallback to fp16 for long-seq bursts (Ethan).
- Run full Redwood-QEval v2 across Llama-3 family and produce a short deck with perf vs quality tradeoffs (Daniel + PM).
- Prepare customer-facing guidance and internal runbook for q4 rollout (Maya + Support).

Notes/Quick links: see linked_artifacts for Jira tickets and runtime PR. Follow-up sync: adhoc triage mid-week if regression persists.

-- End of notes
